A [[human]] '''farmer''' resided on the agricultural<ref name="Harvest" /> [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]].<ref name="General Store">{{Databank|mina-rau-general-store|Mina-Rau General Store}}</ref> They had light skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s curly brown [[hair]] and a brown beard. In [[4 BBY]], they attended at least one communal gathering between local [[farmer]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]] on Mina-Rau. They ate a meal at the gathering next another [[Unidentified farmer 1 (Mina-Rau)|farmer]] at long table. While eating they joked around with the fellow attendees including poking fun at to [[Brasso]]'s relationship with [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]], to which Brasso playfully threw a piece of food at them. During the gathering wore a brown [[clothing|shirt]] under a orange-brown apron.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
The farmer appeared in the third episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]], "[[Harvest]]", of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[April 22]] [[2025]]. They were portrayed by [[John Wark]] in the episode.<ref name="Harvest" />
